name: DukaanSaathi AI
description: Street Vendor Digitalization Agent: shop profile, product catalogue and marketing content for Indian street vendors, written with IBM Granite and approved by the vendor.
note: Project descriptor for this FastAPI app. It is not a LangFlow export.

stack.ai: IBM Granite via IBM watsonx.ai (IBM Cloud Lite)

ibm.status: Live call not yet verified with real credentials; confirm model and Lite quota in your IBM Cloud account.

modes.ibm-granite: Used when IBM_API_KEY and IBM_PROJECT_ID are set and DEMO_MODE is not true. A failed IBM call returns HTTP 502; there is no silent fallback.
modes.demo: Labelled template text, not AI output.

workflow: Load shop and product context from SQLite
Build prompt and call IBM Granite (or labelled demo template)
Validate output (length, markup, risky claims, PIN/OTP requests)
Save as draft; vendor edits and approves
safeguards: Vendor approves every draft; nothing is sent, paid for or submitted automatically
Never asks for UPI PIN, OTP or passwords
Scheme information lists official links only
Generated text labelled as an AI suggestion, not a guarantee
API keys stay in server environment variables
limitations: Single vendor, no login, SQLite prototype. Add authentication and a managed database before real use.
